brief.prompt: Improve existing Wooden Roller Coaster ride {ride_id}, which is already testing but has low excitement. Preserve its first three station pieces and all other rides. Close it before editing. Revise its layout and retest based on observations. Aim for excitement >= 3.0 and intensity <= 8.0 on the game decimal scale. Every target track-element tile must remain within x=20..125 and y=20..125 inclusive. Leave the same ride ID with a complete circuit, station entrance and exit, calculated ratings and moving trains, testing in the unpaused sandbox. Choose the design yourself. Report the ride ID, ratings and any unmet requirements.
